mockWorker.description: Selects a worker dispatch and declares the deterministic behavior to apply at the execution boundary.

runType.description: Required run-type union selecting accept, script, or reject behavior.

rejectConfig.description: Optional observable output for a rejected mock result when runType is reject.

exitCode.description: Optional rejected exit code between 1 and 255.

usage.description: Optional canonical provider usage emitted once for a matched mock dispatch.

cachedInputTokens.description: Optional non-negative cached-input token count; when set it must not exceed inputTokens.

inputTokens.description: Optional non-negative input token count; explicit zero remains declared.

model.description: Required non-empty model identity when usage is present.

outputTokens.description: Optional non-negative output token count; explicit zero remains declared.

provider.description: Required non-empty provider identity when usage is present.

reasoningOutputTokens.description: Optional non-negative reasoning-output token count; when set it must not exceed outputTokens.

scriptConfig.description: Declares the local script a script mock executes through the shared command-runner boundary.

command.description: Required non-empty command when runType is script.

timeout.description: Optional local script execution time bound (for example 30s). Not a dispatch delay or timing field.

workInput.description: Narrows a mock-worker match by consumed work input. Omitted selector fields do not constrain that dimension.

contract.entrySelectionPolicy: first matching mockWorkers[] entry wins; there is no response-sequence or multi-hit authoring surface beyond that first-match selection

mockWorkers.defaultEmptyBehavior: missing mockWorkers decodes as an empty slice; nil after decode is normalized to []

description.canonicalEnglish: Ordered mock-worker entries matched in array order; the first matching entry wins.

mockWorkers.notes: LoadMockWorkersConfig with an empty path returns NewEmptyMockWorkersConfig without reading a file

contract.runTypeUnionSummary: runType is required on every mockWorkers[] entry and selects which nested config shape Validate enforces
contract.unknownFieldPolicy: ParseMockWorkersConfig ignores unknown object fields and reports sorted unique JSON paths; known-field validation and exactly one JSON document remain strict

description: The forward-compatible mock-worker dispatch configuration accepted by ParseMockWorkersConfig. Unknown object fields are ignored with path-only diagnostics; known fields remain validated. mockWorkers[] entries are matched in array order and the first matching entry wins. Unmatched dispatches follow unmatchedDispatchPolicy.

mockWorkers.description: Ordered mock-worker entries. First-match selection applies; there is no multi-step response-sequence authoring surface.

unmatchedDispatchPolicy.description: Controls dispatches that do not match any mockWorkers[] entry. Omitted values behave as accept.
